name: JobsPipe: Get Company Enrichment
description: Enrich a company with details like headcount, location, description, and LinkedIn
notes: Replace YOUR_JOBSPIPE_API_KEY with your actual API key
Replace {key} in URL path with Clay column reference to company_domain
Can also use company name, email, or careers URL as the key
Costs 1 credit per successful lookup (404 responses are free)
Returns enriched company data from job posting sources
Companies appear here once they've posted at least one job
